name: Charlie Health IOP
one_liner: Virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP) for teens, young adults, and families with 600+ insurance plans accepted.
short_description: Charlie Health is a virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP) for adolescents, young adults, and families dealing with serious mental health conditions.
long_description: Charlie Health is a virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP) specializing in teens (ages 11-17), young adults (18-30), and families experiencing serious mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation, trauma, eating disorders, and substance use. The program provides 9-12 hours of treatment per week over 9-12 weeks, including three group therapy sessions and one individual therapy session weekly. Sessions are available mornings, afternoons, and evenings with flexible scheduling. Charlie Health is covered by 600+ insurance plans including most major commercial insurers and Medicaid in participating states. For those without coverage, self-pay options with payment plans are available in select states. Charlie Health also accepts VA referrals for veterans' dependents and offers specialized tracks for specific populations and conditions.
best_for: Teens and young adults needing higher-level mental health care
Families seeking evidence-based IOP for adolescents
Patients with suicidal ideation, self-harm, or crisis history
Those stepping down from inpatient or PHP
not_for: Patients needing full inpatient or residential care
Those seeking weekly outpatient therapy only

faqs.q: How much does Charlie Health cost?
faqs.a: Charlie Health costs vary by insurance plan. The program is covered by 600+ insurance plans including commercial and Medicaid. Self-pay and payment plans are available in select states. Contact their Admissions Team for coverage verification.

faqs.q: What age groups does Charlie Health serve?
faqs.a: Charlie Health serves teens ages 11-17, young adults ages 18-30, and their families. They specialize in adolescent and young adult mental health care.

faqs.q: How intensive is Charlie Health's IOP program?
faqs.a: Charlie Health provides 9-12 hours of treatment per week, including three 3-hour group sessions and one individual therapy session weekly. Treatment typically spans 9-12 weeks.

faqs.q: What conditions does Charlie Health treat?
faqs.a: Charlie Health treats serious mental health conditions including depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation, self-harm, trauma/PTSD, eating disorders, substance use, OCD, personality disorders, and grief.
